# Event handler names ("on" + event type) known to browsers and specs (514 names).
# Every name in this file must be removed by "xss_clean()" (see "EventHandlerAttributeTest").
# Generated by "build/event-handlers/extract.py" (pinned upstream revisions, see there) - do not edit by hand.
#
# Sources (union, lowercased):
# - spec-idl:    WebIDL "EventHandler" attributes from all W3C / WHATWG specs (npm "@webref/idl" 3.87.0)
# - spec-events: event types defined in all W3C / WHATWG specs (npm "@webref/events" 1.28.0)
# - webkit:      Source/WebCore/html/HTMLAttributeNames.in, svg/svgattrs.in, dom/EventNames.json (WebKit d32db58b902c)
# - blink:       core/html/html_attribute_names.json5, core/svg/svg_attribute_names.json5, core/events/event_type_names.json5 (Chromium 2bcfe1515f03)
# - gecko:       dom/events/EventNameList.h (mozilla/gecko-dev 5836a062726f)
#
# Format: <name> <sources>
